ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Prohibitions in Islam Zina? (1 mark)
   A. Use Prohibitions in Islam Zina to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Prohibitions in Islam Zina with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Prohibitions in Islam Zina has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Prohibitions in Islam Zina.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Shariah religion intellect life property dignity? (1 mark)
   A. Use Shariah religion intellect life property dignity to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Shariah religion intellect life property dignity has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Shariah religion intellect life property dignity with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Shariah religion intellect life property dignity.

3. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

4. Which response best shows understanding of Ulum al-Hadith Hadith compilation of Hadith? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Ulum al-Hadith Hadith compilation of Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Ulum al-Hadith Hadith compilation of Hadith to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Ulum al-Hadith Hadith compilation of Hadith has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ulum al-Hadith Hadith compilation of Hadith.

5. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs

6. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in the Last Day Hellfire? (1 mark)
   A. Say Belief in the Last Day Hellfire has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Belief in the Last Day Hellfire with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in the Last Day Hellfire.
   D. Use Belief in the Last Day Hellfire to insult classmates of other faiths.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Domestic violence 06 6.2 Iddah 05 6.3 Child custody 04 6.4 Polygamy in Islam 06 ? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Domestic violence 06 6.2 Iddah 05 6.3 Child custody 04 6.4 Polygamy in Islam 06 .
   B. Say Domestic violence 06 6.2 Iddah 05 6.3 Child custody 04 6.4 Polygamy in Islam 06  has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Domestic violence 06 6.2 Iddah 05 6.3 Child custody 04 6.4 Polygamy in Islam 06  with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Domestic violence 06 6.2 Iddah 05 6.3 Child custody 04 6.4 Polygamy in Islam 06  to insult classmates of other faiths.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Tawbah? (1 mark)
   A. Use Tawbah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Tawbah.
   C. Say Tawbah has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Tawbah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Spreading rumours

10. Which response best shows understanding of Ulum al- Qur’an miraculous nature of the Qur’an the Qur’an Qur’an? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Ulum al- Qur’an miraculous nature of the Qur’an the Qur’an Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Ulum al- Qur’an miraculous nature of the Qur’an the Qur’an Qur’an to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Ulum al- Qur’an miraculous nature of the Qur’an the Qur’an Qur’an has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ulum al- Qur’an miraculous nature of the Qur’an the Qur’an Qur’an.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Hadith Unity Avoidance of ill motives? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Selected Hadith Unity Avoidance of ill motives with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Hadith Unity Avoidance of ill motives.
   C. Use Selected Hadith Unity Avoidance of ill motives to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Selected Hadith Unity Avoidance of ill motives has no place in daily life.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Virtues in Islam? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Virtues in Islam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Virtues in Islam to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Virtues in Islam has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Virtues in Islam.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Contemporary Issues and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Islam in Kenya 07 7.2 Unity of Muslims 04 7.3 Muslim Institutions 09 Total Numbe and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Islam in Kenya Eastern Kenya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Unity of Muslims and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

6. B — Apply the teaching of Belief in the Last Day Hellfire with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. C — Apply the teaching of Domestic violence 06 6.2 Iddah 05 6.3 Child custody 04 6.4 Polygamy in Islam 06  with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. D — Apply the teaching of Tawbah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. C — Telling the truth and keeping trust

10. A — Apply the teaching of Ulum al- Qur’an miraculous nature of the Qur’an the Qur’an Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. A — Apply the teaching of Virtues in Islam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

16. (4 marks)
